title: Exemption from taxation.
bodyText: The authority shall not be required to pay assessments levied by any county, nor shall the authority be required to pay state taxes of any kind.
bodyHtml: [§206E-17]  Exemption from taxation.  The authority shall not be required to pay assessments levied by any county, nor shall the authority be required to pay state taxes of any kind. [L 1976, c 153, pt of §1]
